messages.content: Write the PLC logic implementation for an Aerospace Composite Autoclave Curing Profile Sequencer in IEC 61131-3. It should include multi-zone thermocouple averaging, nitrogen pressurization ramps, exothermic reaction detection (runaway temperature alarms), safety interlocks (e-stops, thermal overloads), and robust hardware abstractions.

I need to upgrade a simple analog sensor read block into a complete, enterprise-grade Commercial Hydroponic Greenhouse controller in IEC 61131-3 Structured Text.
Please implement:
1. Hardware abstractions for analog inputs (Temperature, Humidity, EC, pH) with fault detection.
2. Vapor Pressure Deficit (VPD) calculations for climate monitoring.
3. Dynamic LED grow-light spectrum shifting (Red/Blue intensity ratios) based on a state machine for the plant lifecycle (Seedling, Vegetative, Flowering, Harvest).
4. Nutrient dosing pumps (A, B, pH Up, pH Down) with step-dosing state machines.
5. Safety interlocks including E-stops and thermal overload monitoring for the pumps.
Ensure the code includes flawless, production-ready comments and robust error handling.

Evolve a basic state machine from the tier1 seeds into a SIL-4 rated Theme Park Roller Coaster Block Zone controller. Implement redundant wheel-sensor tracking, anti-rollback ratchet monitoring, and fail-safe magnetic brake deployment if block zones are violated.

Design a highly complex, production-ready IEC 61131-3 Hydroelectric Dam Spillway Controller. It must include upstream watershed level predictions, redundant ultrasonic level sensors, radial Tainter gate synchronous lifting logic to prevent structural vibration, comprehensive safety interlocks (E-Stops, thermal overloads), and hardware abstractions. Provide the full Structured Text implementation.

Evolve a basic temperature block into a Quantum Computing Cryostat Dilution Refrigerator controller. Implement ultra-low temperature (milli-Kelvin) He3/He4 isotope mixture regulation, turbo-molecular vacuum pump sequencing, and superconducting magnet quench detection.

Write a highly complex Jet Engine Test Cell controller in IEC 61131-3 Structured Text. It must evolve a basic analog loop into a full system implementing FADEC (Full Authority Digital Engine Control) simulation, thrust vectoring feedback, and turbine inlet temperature (TIT) over-temp shutdown logic. Include complex state machines, safety interlocks (e.g., e-stops, thermal overloads), hardware abstractions, and flawless comments.

Evolve a basic speed control block into a SIL-4 High-Speed Rail (Maglev) Levitation and Propulsion controller. Implement track-segment switching synchronization, eddy-current brake deployment, and millimeter-precision gap control using high-speed laser sensors. Ensure robust safety interlocks and provide comprehensive IEC 61131-3 implementation.

Evolve a basic state machine into a massive Orbital Space Launch Pad Sequencer. Implement Liquid Oxygen (LOX) / Liquid Hydrogen (LH2) cryogenic fueling sequences, sparker ignition verification, and T-0 umbilical retraction interlocks.

Evolve a basic IO block into a Deep Sea ROV (Remotely Operated Vehicle) Subsea Control Module. Implement hydraulic pressure compensation for 6000m depths, umbilical fiber-optic telemetry heartbeat checks, and thruster vectoring matrices in IEC 61131-3 Structured Text.

Evolve this basic state machine concept into a Geothermal Power Plant Steam Turbine sequencer. 
Implement reinjection well pump synchronization, H2S (Hydrogen Sulfide) gas abatement scrubber control, and turbine overspeed trip logic. 
Include complex state machines, safety interlocks (e.g., e-stops, thermal overloads), hardware abstractions, and flawless comments.

Evolve a basic power block into a massive Grid-Scale Supercapacitor Energy Storage controller using Siemens SCL. Implement millisecond-level frequency regulation response, rapid charge/discharge thermal management, and insulated-gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) firing angles. Ensure the implementation is highly complex, production-ready IEC 61131-3, with complex state machines, safety interlocks (e.g. e-stops, thermal overloads), hardware abstractions, and flawless comments.

Evolve a basic array block into a Particle Accelerator Beam Steering Controller. Implement nano-second synchronized quadrupole magnet pulse shaping, beam position monitor (BPM) feedback loops, and klystron RF power interlocks. Ensure the code is production-ready IEC 61131-3 structured text, highly complex, and includes safety abstractions.

I have a basic motion function block used for single-axis positioning. 

Please evolve this basic motion block into a 30-meter class Astronomical Telescope Mount Controller.
You must implement:
1. Sidereal tracking algorithms.
2. Active optics mirror deformation arrays (to compensate for gravity).
3. Wind-buffeting disturbance rejection.
4. Complex state machines.
5. Safety interlocks (e-stops, thermal overloads).
6. Hardware abstractions and flawless comments.
Evolve a basic timer into a Smart City Traffic Grid Coordinator. Implement Green Wave synchronized cascading, emergency vehicle preemption (EVP) overrides, and pedestrian density sensor integration.

Design an industrial-grade IEC 61131-3 Structured Text program for a massive Reverse Osmosis (RO) Desalination Plant. The system must move far beyond a simple pressure loop by implementing a high-pressure membrane feed pump array with staging, Energy Recovery Device (ERD) synchronization (e.g., isobaric chamber arrays), continuous permeate salinity tracking (calculating TDS from conductivity and temperature with strict reject thresholds), and complex state management (Off, Standby, Pre-Flush, Ramp Up, Production, Post-Flush, CIP). It must include robust safety interlocks such as e-stops, motor thermal overloads, VFD fault monitoring, and low/high pressure cutoffs across the membrane array. Provide deeply commented, production-ready code with complete variable declarations and hardware abstractions.

Design a highly complex, production-ready IEC 61131-3 PLC program for a massive Broadway Theatrical Stage Automation controller. The system must coordinate SIL-3 rated overhead performer flying winches and synchronize sub-stage hydraulic lifts. It must include rigorous safety constraints such as hardware and software e-stops, dead-man switch interlocks, thermal overload monitoring, cross-checking redundancy for the SIL-3 rating, and complex state machines for motion sequences.

I have a basic sequencer for a conveyor belt in IEC 61131-3. Can you evolve it into a massive Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) controller? You must implement cutterhead torque distribution across multi-drive motors, earth-pressure balance (EPB) slurry face control, and segmental concrete ring erector sequencing. Ensure the code includes complex state machines, safety interlocks (e.g., e-stops, thermal overloads), hardware abstractions, and flawless comments.

Act as a Lead Drive Systems Engineer at a massive Pulp & Paper Mill. Write a complete, highly complex IEC 61131-3 Structured Text (ST) program for a Fourdrinier Paper Machine Sectional Drive Controller.
Your implementation must include:
1. 40-axis precise electronic speed cascading (draw control) to maintain web tension across the wire, press, and dryer sections without tearing the wet paper web.
2. Infrared moisture scanner integration to control the steam pressure in the Yankee dryer cylinder.
3. Massive moment of inertia (flywheel effect) acceleration/deceleration ramping to prevent breaking the mechanical drive shafts during startup.
Include safety interlocks, hardware abstractions, state machines, and flawless comments.

You are acting as a Principal CNC Architect at a global machine tool builder (e.g., DMG Mori or Siemens). Evolve a basic motion block into a 5-Axis CNC Milling Machine interpolation engine.

Technical Specifications required in the ST code:
1. Tool Center Point Management (TCPM) calculating continuous 5-axis kinematic transformations (X, Y, Z, A, C axes) to keep the cutting tool perfectly normal to the surface.
2. Spindle vibration monitoring (using piezoelectric accelerometers) to automatically reduce feed rate and prevent chatter (chatter suppression).
3. Automatic Tool Changer (ATC) carousel sequencing with absolute encoder verification.

You are acting as a Principal Packaging Engineer for a high-speed bottling OEM (e.g., Krones). Evolve a basic timer block into a High-Speed Rotary Beverage Filler and Capper (120,000 bottles per hour).

Technical Specifications required in the ST code:
1. Electronic camming (MC_CamIn) to synchronize the rotary filler bowl with the infeed starwheels.
2. Fill-level mass flow meter tracking per individual valve, cutting off fluid flow with millisecond precision based on target volume.
3. High-speed camera (Cognex) rejection integration: if a cap is detected as skewed, trigger a pneumatic blow-off valve precisely 4.2 seconds later downstream.

You are acting as a Lead Aviation Integrator at a major international airport (e.g., Denver or Dubai). Evolve a basic array block into a massive ICS (Individual Carrier System) Baggage Handling routing matrix.

Technical Specifications required in the ST code:
1. RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) read/write tracking at 10 meters per second.
2. High-speed diverter paddle actuation using predictive encoder-based timing windows.
3. Early Baggage Storage (EBS) automated crane sequencing for holding layover luggage.
4. Anti-gridlock cascading stop logic if a downstream TSA explosive detection scanner faults.

Evolve a basic PID block into a SIL-4 rated Dynamic Positioning Class 3 (DP3) Vessel Controller for a deepwater drillship.

Technical Specifications required in the ST code:
1. Multi-reference positioning matrices: blend GPS, hydroacoustic position reference (HPR), and taut-wire sensor data into a single Kalman filter to calculate the exact vessel X/Y/Yaw coordinates.
2. Thruster Allocation Logic (TAL): distribute the required restoring force across 6 azimuth thrusters, optimizing for minimal fuel consumption while completely neutralizing ocean current and wind vectors.
3. Triple-modular redundancy (TMR) voting logic for the main gyrocompasses. If one gyro deviates by more than 0.5 degrees from the other two, instantly isolate it and sound a DP yellow alert.

As a Lead Agritech Automation Engineer for a massive Urban Vertical Farming startup, evolve a basic timer block into an Ultra-Precision Aeroponic Nutrient Dosing and Misting Controller.

Technical Specifications required in the ST code:
1. Micro-misting solenoid sequencing: Pulse high-pressure solenoids for exactly 2.5 seconds every 5 minutes to deliver atomized nutrient fog directly to bare plant roots without waterlogging.
2. In-line pH and Electrical Conductivity (EC) sensor monitoring to dynamically adjust the injection rate of 3 separate macro-nutrient dosing pumps using floating PID logic.
3. UV sterilization and ozone water-treatment interlocks on the recirculation return lines.

You are acting as a Lead Process Automation Engineer for a massive Commercial Bakery (e.g., Bimbo Bakeries). Evolve a basic timer block into a Continuous Proofing and Tunnel Oven Controller capable of producing 20,000 loaves of bread per hour.

Technical Specifications required in the ST code:
1. Dynamic psychrometric humidity control in the proofer using steam injection valves and wet-bulb/dry-bulb temperature sensors.
2. 100-meter Tunnel Oven multi-zone temperature profiling using modulating gas burner valves and flame safeguard interlocks.
3. Conveyor belt tracking: If a physical gap is detected in the dough pan spacing, the oven burner PID setpoints must automatically drop to prevent flash-burning the empty space and triggering a fire alarm.

You are acting as a Lead Show-Action Engineer for a top-tier theme park design firm (e.g., Disney Imagineering). Evolve a basic motion block into a 64-Axis Audio-Animatronic Figure Controller.

Technical Specifications required in the ST code:
1. SMPTE Timecode synchronization: The PLC must sync massive hydraulic valve arrays (proportional valves) to an incoming audio timecode with sub-millisecond precision.
2. Electronic camming profiles for smooth, lifelike acceleration/deceleration of the animatronic joints to prevent mechanical "jerking".
3. Hydraulic pressure envelope monitoring: If a servo-valve fails open, instantly trigger a dump-valve to prevent the animatronic arm from crashing into the ride vehicle path.
